text: 三季度黄金ETF与央行购金强势护盘，世界黄金协会：年末投资需求或比去年增约200吨 报告表示，尽管三季度全球黄金总需求同比微降，但投资需求尤其是黄金ETF买盘强势回归成为主要动力，央行购金规模创下新高，高金价则持续抑制金饰需求。
text_en: Gold ETFs and Central Bank Buying Strongly Supported the Market in Q3; World Gold Council: Year-End Investment Demand May Increase by About 200 Tons Compared With Last Year The report said that although total global gold demand edged down year on year in Q3, the strong return of investment demand, especially gold ETF buying, became the main driver, central bank gold purchases hit a new high, and high gold prices continued to suppress jewelry demand.
